title: Viral Posts
summary: Find the post shapes that went viral for you more than once, write a small batch of new Threads posts on those exact skeletons from your own facts, check every post, and propose a schedule that only runs after your yes on the exact batch.
triggers: write posts from my viral templates
turn my viral posts into new posts
what keeps going viral for me

inputs.name: the creator's own published posts with view counts, saved viral posts and Brain facts, or pasted posts with view counts when no account is connected

outputs.name: template evidence, checked drafts with every thread part, a schedule proposal and a receipt

free_capabilities: local template finding, drafting checks and schedule proposal from posts the creator pastes
paid_capability_stubs: Hosted Threadify analytics, Brain and generation tools need a current connection and plan access

must_show: template and its evidence posts with view counts
exact text of every part of every post
exact time and timezone for every post
media per post (none: text posts only)
drafts already saved by generation, by id
check results and stable idempotency key per post

instructions: Without a working connection, ask the creator to paste their best posts with view counts, the full text of every part of each post a template copies, their 10 most recent posts with view counts, and the facts each new post may use.
A cut-off or partial source post leaves its template shape unverified and out of the batch; a template whose posts carried a picture needs media and stays out of this text-only batch.
Find templates, fill them, run the same checks and propose tentative slots locally; label every slot unverified against the live calendar.
Never claim Threadify generated, validated or scheduled anything; record the fallback in the receipt.

must_prove: templates with evidence posts and view counts
exact approved text of every part
schedule proposal with live calendar total
drafting yes and saved draft ids
intent fingerprint, returned scheduled post id and state per post
